info.title: API.SH: AniList
info.description: The AniList API from API.SH: public AniList data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Upcoming and past anime episode air times: each entry has the episode number, air time (ISO), seconds until it airs and the anime (id, MyAnimeList id, titles, format, status, season, year, episodes, duration, country, score, popularity, genres, cover and link). Without `id` or a date range it lists the next 7 days. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/anilist-airing

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date or time (2026-11-03, an ISO time or a unix time).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date or time (a date includes the whole day).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One anime only: an AniList id, an AniList link or a MyAnimeList link.

parameters.name: mal_id
parameters.description: One anime by its MyAnimeList id.

parameters.name: not_yet_aired
parameters.description: 1 = only episodes still to air, 0 = only aired ones.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Also `airing_schedule` (episode numbers with their air time, first 25 known episodes; `airing_schedule_total` gives the full count), `upcoming_episodes` (next 25 episodes not yet aired, with seconds until airing).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
Search anime or manga with every AniList filter: format, status, genres (include/exclude), tags, season and year, source, country, score and episode ranges, licensed, adult, sort. Each result: id, MyAnimeList id, type, format, status, titles (romaji, English, native), synonyms, description, start and end dates, season, episodes, duration, chapters, volumes, country, source, cover and banner, genres, average and mean score, popularity, favourites, trending, next airing episode, studios and link. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/anilist-search

parameters.name: source

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
